# Antivibecoding VPN (landing page)

> This website, https://general.substituteme.space/, is open source under the MIT licence.
> Source code: https://github.com/Glebsolopdf/avv-card

The site is a static, framework-free one-page landing page (HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript).
Tariffs and server countries are loaded from a public data/data.json that a small Node script
(scripts/refresh.mjs in the repository) refreshes from the service backend.

## Links
- [Repository](https://github.com/Glebsolopdf/avv-card): full source of this website
- [Licence](https://github.com/Glebsolopdf/avv-card/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/Glebsolopdf/avv-card/blob/main/NOTICE.md): flag-icons (MIT), Onest and Jost fonts (SIL OFL 1.1)
- [README (ru)](https://github.com/Glebsolopdf/avv-card/blob/main/README.md) and [README (en)](https://github.com/Glebsolopdf/avv-card/blob/main/README.en.md)

## Scope
Only this landing page is open source. The VPN service backend, the customer cabinet and the Telegram bot are separate, not published here.
